note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Complete best-ranked Wikidata P625 screen with non-deprecated multi-coordinate items held. Exact ISO 3166-2 CSC state to shapeISO boundary match. Both points inside/outside, invalid geometries, ambiguous states, special/disputed territories and <=0.01 degree boundary margins held. Clear requires an independent exact named GeoNames settlement within 5 km inside own state and item P131/point proved in another state/country. Move requires exact native/official name, fitting direct P31, current P131 to own state, unique item across CSC tables, inside-item/outside-row boundary proof and 8-decimal CC0 P625 coordinates.
exact CSC state iso3166_2 == geoBoundaries shapeISO
distance_method: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic; threshold strictly >25 km; multi-coordinate items held even where only one preferred value exists
licence_policy: Only CC BY 4.0 boundaries authorize corrections unless explicit user authorization is archived in work/allow_other_open_licences.json
